headline: Cherry Lane: no parking for 175 feet on odd-numbered side recommended to city council.
summary: Cherry Lane is a 250-foot dead-end street, 20 feet wide, and residents who spoke had mixed views, with some saying visitors and medical visits need the parking. The City Council will take it up, probably in January, and would hold two readings and then wait 30 days before any change takes effect. Sketches were also shown for a traffic calming demonstration project on Outer Main Street next summer.
decisions: Recommended to the City Council a no-parking rule on the odd-numbered side of Cherry Lane for 175 feet from Elm Street.
discussion: Cherry Lane parking options: Three options were put forward: leave parking as is, ban it on the odd-numbered side for the full dead end, or ban it for 175 feet from Elm Street. Members favored the 175-foot option as a compromise, noting a code guide that 20-foot streets should have no parking on either side.

Resident comments on Cherry Lane: Several residents spoke for keeping parking because visitors and home health staff need it. Others wanted a ban, saying backing out is hard, and one said she hit a parked car while backing out.
Other parking ideas: Members suggested a delivery or visitor spot near the Elm Street entrance. They also said the building manager would be asked to tell tenants about the meeting.

Outer Main Street demonstration: Sketches showed flex posts, curb extensions, and a northbound bike lane toward Rotary Park. Members asked whether a southbound lane fits the road, and next steps include a meeting with public works and MDOT, probably in mid or late December.

Parkview Court parking request: A presenter said the owner plans to add about a dozen spots off Main Street, with 20 more when new construction starts next year. The presenter recommended keeping the street parking ban, citing plowing and fire truck access.

decision_evidence.quote: move that we advance the draft council order with the 175 foot language to council. ... So what's gonna happen now is we made a recommendation that there be no parking on the left side of the street, the odd numbered side of the street, for a distance of a hundred and seventy-five feet.

decision_titles: No parking on odd-numbered side of Cherry Lane, 175 feet
